description: The five plots in Figure 4.1 share the same x-axis and y-axis, with the x-axis labeled "epoch" and having a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6 with a tick label interval of 1, and the y-axis labeled "WER" with varying linear scales across the plots. The first plot, titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny", illustrates the change in WER during fine-tuning for different configurations, with the gray solid line with diamond markers (tiny AdaLoRA_int4) starting at approximately 55 and decreasing to around 30, the gray dashed line with square markers (tiny AdaLoRA_int8) beginning at about 65 and dropping to roughly 32, the gray dotted line with circle markers (tiny int4) starting at approximately 68 and decreasing to around 33, and the gray dash-dotted line with triangle markers (tiny full) beginning at about 30 and decreasing to roughly 28. The remaining four plots follow a similar structure, with the second plot ("type = base") showing blue lines, the third plot ("type = small") displaying orange lines, the fourth plot ("type = medium") showing green lines, and the fifth plot ("type = large") illustrating purple lines, each with distinct marker shapes and line styles representing different configurations, and all generally decreasing across the x-axis.
